88	// Anthropic structured outputs (output_config.format) only accept type/enum/shape
89	// keywords — NOT the numeric (minimum/maximum/multipleOf), string (min/maxLength),
90	// or array (min/maxItems/uniqueItems) validation keywords that z.toJSONSchema()
91	// emits from our .min()/.max()/.int() refinements. Sending them 400s. We strip them
92	// here; the exact bounds are still enforced after the call by TagSchema.parse().
93	const UNSUPPORTED_JSON_SCHEMA_KEYWORDS = new Set([
94	  "minimum", "maximum", "exclusiveMinimum", "exclusiveMaximum", "multipleOf",
95	  "minLength", "maxLength",
96	  "minItems", "maxItems", "uniqueItems",
97	]);

99	export function forStructuredOutput(node: unknown): unknown {
100	  if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.map(forStructuredOutput);
101	  if (node && typeof node === "object") {
102	    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
103	    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(node)) {
104	      if (UNSUPPORTED_JSON_SCHEMA_KEYWORDS.has(key)) continue;
105	      out[key] = forStructuredOutput(value);
106	    }
107	    // Structured outputs require every object to forbid extra properties.
108	    if (out.type === "object" && !("additionalProperties" in out)) {
109	      out.additionalProperties = false;
110	    }
111	    return out;
112	  }
113	  return node;
114	}
115	
116	// Zod 4 native JSON Schema, sanitised for Anthropic's output_config.format.
117	export const taggingJsonSchema = forStructuredOutput(
118	  z.toJSONSchema(TagSchema),
119	) as Record<string, unknown>;

content.text:
Based on my analysis:

**Files reviewed:**
- `app/closet/[itemId]/actions.ts` — Server Action `updateItem` (RLS-scoped via `items_all_own` policy: `auth.uid() = user_id`)
- `lib/closet/update-schema.ts` — new Zod schema validating every field before DB write
- `components/closet/item-detail.tsx` — client caller
- `components/capture/confirm-form.tsx` — captures AI-draft edits (no direct sinks)
- `components/closet/color-picker.tsx` — enum-based picker
- `supabase/migrations/20260615114702_items.sql` — confirmed RLS policy uses `auth.uid()` for both `using` and `with check`

**Verified boundaries:**
- IDOR: `.eq("id", itemId)` is safe because Supabase RLS `items_all_own` policy enforces `auth.uid() = user_id` on `for all` (both `USING` and `WITH CHECK`). A foreign itemId matches 0 rows.
- Enum inputs (`category, colors, pattern, material, texture, formality, seasons`) all constrained via `TagSchema.shape.*`, matching CHECK constraints in Postgres.
- `price: z.number().nonnegative().nullable()` — `.nonnegative()` rejects negative and NaN; range only affects the user's own row.
- Free-text `subcategory` / `name` are rendered via JSX (React auto-escapes) so no XSS; stored in owner-scoped rows.
- No new sinks: no shell/eval/SQL-raw/SSRF/path/log-injection; no auth logic changed; no new registry that a sibling path could bypass; sibling `archiveItem` is unchanged; `confirmItem` (insert path) already uses `TagSchema.parse` before insert.
- User can only mutate their own record; even a malicious price/subcategory string is self-inflicted.

No exploitable path from source → sink survives.
